data.short_description: Hazel is a farm-driven restaurant serving Mediterranean-inspired, locally sourced cuisine, first opened in 2015 by Jim and Michele Wimborough. It will soon reopen at a new address, 3688 Bohemian Highway, in one of Occidental's historic properties, though an official opening date has not been announced. Signature dishes such as crispy fried Brussels sprouts, slow-braised pot roast, and the Hazel Sundae are expected to remain.

data.short_description: Endura LLC is the entity behind a possible new full-service restaurant planned for the former Round Table Pizza space at 815 1st St in downtown Gilroy. This does not qualify as an opening/closing/remodel event because it reflects only a Type 41 On Sale Beer and Wine ABC license application filed June 24, with no concept or opening timeline disclosed. The existing restaurant footprint could help streamline the transition once an operator moves forward.
